memory_update.text: AMKR should be treated as a reference anchor for US-listed advanced packaging and OSAT demand, not the main underfollowed alpha target.
CAMT is a strong underfollowed-lane candidate for HBM/advanced-packaging inspection and metrology; next layer should verify HBM-specific revenue materiality and customer concentration.
FORM is a strong underfollowed-lane candidate for HBM probe-card and known-good-die test exposure; next layer should track DRAM/HBM probe-card revenue growth and major memory-customer dependence.

KLIC is a hypothesis-stage underfollowed bonding-equipment candidate; survival into Layer 2 depends on evidence that thermocompression/advanced-packaging orders are HBM/AI material rather than legacy packaging cyclicality.
ONTO was not selected due to the four-name cap, but its disclosed HBM manufacturer purchase agreement makes it a likely priority add in a later HBM inspection/metrology pass.

summary: Layer 1B expansion for the HBM/advanced-packaging sub-supplier node. The reference anchor is AMKR as a US-listed OSAT/advanced-packaging platform. The discovery lane emphasizes smaller, narrower public suppliers tied to inspection/metrology, HBM probe-card test, and thermocompression/advanced bonding equipment. These are research candidates only, not buy/sell recommendations. Market-cap buckets are approximate as of 2026-06-10 finance-tool checks and should be refreshed before later Serenity layers.
